meta.title: Ghost Studio | Production & Creation
meta.description: Production and creation studio. We transform ideas into experiences.

brazilShowcase.description: World-class locations, legendary talent, and stories only Brazil can tell. From the streets of Rio to the Amazon rainforest — we bring your vision to life.

whyWorkWithUs.title: WE DON'T JUST PRODUCE — WE CREATE EXPERIENCES THAT CONNECT BRANDS TO PEOPLE.

items.title: PRODUCTION
items.description: From planning to final delivery, we manage every stage of production with precision and attention to detail. Our role is to create a seamless experience, allowing ideas to move confidently from concept to execution.

items.title: CREATIVE DIRECTION
items.description: Every remarkable production begins long before the first frame. We help brands define the creative vision, shape compelling concepts and build visual languages that transform ideas into stories with clarity, purpose and lasting impact.

items.title: BRAND FILMS
items.description: We create films that build emotional connections between brands and people. Every frame is crafted to communicate purpose, evoke emotion and leave a lasting impression beyond the screen.

items.title: PRODUCTION SERVICES
items.description: Brazil offers extraordinary creative possibilities, but successful productions depend on local expertise. We provide complete production support for international teams, coordinating locations, permits, logistics, crew and on-set operations to ensure every production runs efficiently from arrival to wrap.

items.question: How long does a project take?
items.answer: It depends on scope and complexity, but we deliver most projects in 2 to 8 weeks.

items.question: Do you work with any budget?
items.answer: Projects starting at R$ 5,000. Each project is quoted according to your specific needs.

items.question: Do you work outside of São Paulo?
items.answer: Yes, we work across Brazil. We can send our team to any city.

items.question: How does the process work?
items.answer: Briefing → Concept → Production → Delivery. We keep you involved at every stage.
